column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rules policy for the local production preview
# The baseline scan runs with fail_action: true and WITHOUT the blanket `-I`
# WARN suppression: any new WARN or FAIL alert fails the job. This file is the
# only suppression mechanism, and every entry must name one exact ZAP rule ID
# plus the rationale a reviewer accepted. `npm run workflows:check` enforces
# To accept a new alert: reproduce it against the local preview
# (`npm run build` then `npm run preview`), triage it, and add the exact rule
# ID with its rationale in the same pull request. Never silence an entire
# The entries below are header-hardening alerts raised against `vite preview`.
# The preview server is a local scan target for the static artifact, not a
# production host: response headers are owned by the production hosts
# (Vercel, GitHub Pages), and this client-only demo carries no authenticated
# state, cookies, or powerful browser features. Accepting them locally does
# not waive them for a production deployment.

column3: Missing Anti-clickjacking Header: the client-only demo has no authenticated or sensitive state to protect from framing; X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors are production-host headers, not artifact defects.
X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing: vite preview serves the static artifact with correct content types; nosniff is a production-host header concern, reviewed for the local scan only.

Content Security Policy Header Not Set: CSP is delivered by the production host for this client-only demo; the artifact ships no inline scripts or third-party origins that a local preview CSP would govern.
Permissions Policy Header Not Set: the demo uses no powerful browser features (camera, microphone, geolocation); the header is a production-host concern for the local preview scan.
